title: A Glance to the Past
description: A Glance to the Past: A fun scavenger hunt for the texture that is different from the original
body:
# A Glance to the Past Have you ever been bored in a minecraft world? Have you ever wanted to play a fun game in minecraft? well this pack is for you! Introducing : A Glance to the Past: A very fun scavenger hunt for the altered texture from earlier minecraft versions. Test your knowledge from different minecraft versions with this texture pack! ## how to check if you guessed correctly join the discord at https://discord.gg/xG4ncne7G2 and there should be a channel named "check-answers", in that channel find the corresponding hunt and click the grey box right after "hint" for a hint and the grey box after "answer" for the answer, make sure to not spoil the answer for yourself! ## Current Versions:
- 1.7.3 (1 hunt)
## Versions to be included:
- 1.9
- 1.12
- 1.16
- 1.17/1.18
- And More!
